sentences.text: This module covers how you know where the boat is and what the water and weather are doing, and it spans more topics than any other part of the exam.
Latitude measures distance north or south of the equator, from zero to ninety degrees.
Longitude measures distance east or west of the prime meridian at Greenwich, from zero to one hundred eighty degrees.
All of Florida is north latitude and west longitude.
Each degree divides into sixty minutes.
On the chart you read latitude on the side scales and longitude on the top and bottom scales, and a position is always written latitude first.
